source.prompt:
Create one combination logo for GROVE SUPPLY. Industry: Sustainable outdoor goods. Audience: Practical outdoor enthusiasts.
Exact text (copy verbatim, no other words): 'GROVE SUPPLY'. Exact slogan: ''.
Styles: bold, organic, flat. Original brief palette context: #247A52, #F6F3EC.
Avoid: gradients, shadows, mockups, extra lettering, textures. Use cases: website header, small brand label.
Background: transparent. Produce a real PNG raster image. Use clean, readable shapes at small sizes; leave safe margins. Do not draw a transparency checkerboard, mockup, watermarks, or a concept grid.
Concept direction: An iconic broad leaf-and-trail silhouette on the left, with GROVE above SUPPLY on the right. Large completely flat #247A52 green forms, small ivory companion shapes, transparent outside. Preserve exact green anchor without lighting or gradient.. Assumptions: Fictional demonstration brand, Font family is a requested visual reference, not an installed font.
Effective structured palette intent (authoritative over historical palette): {"swatches":[{"hex":"#247A52","role":"primary leaf and lettering"},{"hex":"#F6F3EC","role":"small companion details"}],"constraints":{"locked_hex":["#247A52"],"allowed_hex":null,"max_colors":null,"required_hex":[],"allow_gradients":false},"source":"assistant","source_evidence":{"reference_id":null,"reference_sha256":null,"provider":null,"tool":null,"response":null,"notes":["Palette chosen by the assistant from the brief; not an external provider response"]},"selected_by":"assistant","rationale":"Keep the requested green exactly in intent; ivory provides a quiet secondary detail.","calculation_version":"logo-color-v1","id":"p1","parent_palette_id":null,"digest":"3a0927ec309683f5d6910dfbe26f4ce63b0d56db55db936fd5a31dc93c64d8c0"}. Keep locked and required HEX values exactly in intent; use the declared roles and allowed colors/count. Opaque backgrounds count as visible design colors; transparent pixels do not. No gradients unless allowed. Raster fidelity is measured after generation, never promised as exact pixels.
Effective symbol-plus-text lockup: {"layout":"horizontal","symbol_position":"start","text_alignment":"start","typography_style":"bold geometric sans-serif capitals with clear spacing and open counters","font_reference":"Montserrat"}. Horizontal start/end means symbol left/right of text; stacked start/end means symbol above/below text. Preserve the exact text and slogan. Font reference is a requested visual direction, not proof of an installed or licensed font file.
Return only one standalone, beautifully balanced master logo image, not a presentation sheet. Use large flat solid areas with no texture, lighting, gradients, shadows or three-dimensional effects. Maintain generous margins.
Return a genuine RGBA PNG with a fully transparent exterior (alpha 0) and visible, mostly fully opaque foreground. Preserve intentional ivory/white details. Do not draw a checkerboard, backing panel or opaque background. Use clean antialiasing only at shape edges.

Transparency composites without visible fringe. Small internal details reduce at 128 px; green lettering has limited contrast on dark surfaces. Recommended for light surfaces.

intended_palette.rationale: Keep the requested green exactly in intent; ivory provides a quiet secondary detail.

warnings: Untagged PNG colors are assumed sRGB; no embedded profile confirms this.
color_method: sRGB to Lab D50; CIEDE2000, ColorAide method=2000
color_limits: Sampled raster evidence, not an exact-pixel, Pantone, or print-proof guarantee.
At most 16384 original-coordinate samples; small accents may be missed.
Alpha-zero pixels are excluded; conformance uses alpha >=250 and preserves white.
Strict evidence needs 128 core samples and at most 10% partial-alpha visible samples.
Restricted fit requires 99% core coverage within delta-E00 <=5; design colors need 1% share.
Locks/required colors need 32 matching core samples and 0.5% core share.
Quantized measured swatches are estimates; conformance uses original sampled colors.
Color roles, lettering, and placement require visual review; histograms cannot prove them.
ROI evidence covers only the stated region; opaque full-image evidence includes background.
Contrast ratios on explicit composited surfaces are guidance, not logo AA certification.
